name: Single 18650 battery holder with leads
blurb: A plastic holder with spring contacts and two wire leads for one 18650 lithium cell; it has no protection or charging circuit.

pins.note: Red lead. 3.0 to 4.2 V depending on the cell. The holder has no protection: use a protected cell or add a protection board, and never short it.

search: 18650 battery holder 1 slot with wire leads

verify: Holder dimensions vary widely by maker. Measure the actual holder length, width, wall height and depth with a cell fitted (an 18650 cell is 18 mm diameter and 65 mm long, 18.6 and 65.2 mm max); the holder body height of 10 mm is an assumed wall height and the cell drawn on top is an installed cell. Check lead length and where the leads exit. The 2000 mA supply limit is a placeholder: it depends on the cell, and the holder contacts are usually good for about 2 A only.
sources: No drawing opened. Typical single plastic 18650 holder (about 77 x 21 mm) and the standard 18650 cell size (18 x 65 mm).
